description: Update an existing changelog entry (PATCH — only the fields you send change). Pass the entry UUID from changelog_list. Editable fields: `title`, `version` (still unique per brand — a collision returns 409), and `body`. `body` accepts a Tiptap JSON document OR a { "markdown": "..." } / { "html": "..." } shape — it is normalized to canonical Tiptap server-side, so a markdown body renders correctly (it no longer stores clean but shows title-only). Use this to correct an already-published entry — entries are NOT frozen once created.

body.description: New entry body — Tiptap JSON doc, or {"markdown": "..."} / {"html": "..."} (normalized to Tiptap).

project.description: Optional project — a website inside the workspace (proj_xxx) — to scope this call to. Sent as the X-Project-Id header. If omitted, the spideriq.json / SPIDERIQ_PROJECT_ID binding (or the workspace default project) is used.

published_at.description: Correct the release date (ISO-8601; naive read as UTC). The supported way to re-date a backfilled changelog so the public timeline reads in true release order. Send null to clear it.

version.description: New version label, unique per brand (e.g. "v2.10.0").

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: changelog_update
